<!-- theorem-1: body_md -->
\label{thm:parity}
If a partial Latin square $P$ of order $n$ has fewer than
$\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor$ filled cells, then $N(P)$ is even.
<!-- end theorem-1 -->
<!-- theorem-2: body_md -->
\label{thm:scs}
For every $n\ge1$, \ $\operatorname{scs}(n)=\operatorname{scs}(B_n)=\lfloor n^2/4\rfloor$.
<!-- end theorem-2 -->
